title: Technology Protection Plan Terms: Fee, Enrollment Window, Meal-Status Waivers and Household Ceiling
content:
These are the terms of the Technology Protection Plan of the Student Technology Device Program.

## 1. The fee

The Technology Protection Plan fee, at the loan type's annual plan fee, posts once per loan, on checkout for a plan loan type or on the plan enrollment date.

## 2. Moving a standard-liability loan onto the plan

A standard-liability loan may move onto the plan of the same device type only within the plan enrollment window, 30 days after the device is checked out, counted in calendar days with the checkout date as day 0, and only while no damage incident has been recorded on the loan.

- The clock starts on the checkout date shown on the loan record, which is day 0.
- The move is within the window on any day up to and including day 30; the last day of the window qualifies.
- Both parts must hold: the day is within the window, and no damage incident has been recorded on the loan.

| Hypothetical day of the move (checkout date is day 0) | Damage incident recorded on the loan | Both conditions of the move hold |
|---|---|---|
| Day 12 | None | Yes |
| Day 30 | None | Yes, the boundary day is inside the window |
| Day 31 | None | No, outside the window |
| Day 12 | One recorded | No |

## 3. Waiver by meal status

The fee is waived by credit from the meal status the student holds on the School Nutrition Services Meal Account on the posting date of the fee:

- for any Free Meal Status tier, the share the fee schedule sets for a Free Meal Status tier, credited with the reason free meal waiver;
- for any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier, the share the fee schedule sets for a Reduced-Price Meal Status tier, credited with the reason reduced meal waiver;

each credit being that share of the plan fee rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

## 4. The household ceiling

Plan fees net of waivers are capped per household per school year at the household ceiling in the fee schedule. When a plan fee posts, the amount already counted against the ceiling is the sum of the plan fees on the household's other loans of that school year posted earlier, less the free meal waiver, reduced meal waiver and household cap credits against them. Whatever the new fee net of its waiver, added to that amount, exceeds the ceiling is credited with the reason household cap.

## 5. Return during the year

The plan fee is not credited when the device is returned during the year.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, not schedule figures)

- A hypothetical plan fee of 25.25 with a half waiver: half of 25.25 is 12.625, which rounds up to a credit of 12.63.
- A hypothetical ceiling of 80.00, with earlier plan fees on the household's other loans that school year of 30.00 and 45.00 and no credits against them, counts 75.00 against the ceiling. A new fee of 35.00 with no waiver brings the total to 110.00, so 30.00 of it is credited with the reason household cap and 5.00 remains.
